inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has finally made the right call by banning transgender women and DSD athletes from the women's category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and beyond. IOC president Kirsty Coventry put it plainly when she said it would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category. This is a long-overdue defense of fairness and safety in women's sports, putting biological reality first to protect categories that exist only for actual women. Progressive ideology has been chipping away at the natural order and traditions that keep competition grounded in truth rather than confusion, and it's time we stood firm for personal responsibility and cultural continuity instead of letting institutions cave to it.
